# Covenant Earth Works

> Owner-operated earthworks, road construction, demolition and site preparation. A division of Gerald & Kate Holdings, based in Calgary, Alberta.

Covenant Earth Works is an earthworks, demolition and site preparation contractor based in Calgary, Alberta, Canada. It is a division of **Gerald & Kate Holdings**, a newly established company.

The work is run by two operators:

- **Barry Porter** — earthworks and road construction. 25 years of experience across the construction and logging industries: 20 years in construction, 5 years with logging equipment, demolition, grading and operations. Owns a fleet of 45 machines (25 construction, 20 logging), maintained in-house.
- **Gerald N. Tchio** — demolition and hazardous materials. Interior demolition, complete building demolition, asbestos removal, mould remediation and foundation excavation.

**Phone:** (368) 887-3947
**Address:** Unit 3617, 3800 Block 19 Ave SE, Calgary, Alberta, Canada

## Services

### Division 1 — Heavy road and earthworks
- Road construction and gravel roads
- Mass earthmoving and site balancing
- Industrial pads and hardstands
- Bulk clearing and grubbing
- Subgrade and base compaction
- Lease roads and access

### Division 2 — Residential and commercial site work
- Site preparation and rough grade
- Final and fine grading
- Driveways, approaches and culverts
- Drainage and water management
- Trenching and underground preparation
- Pond and watercourse excavation

### Division 3 — Demolition and hazardous materials
- Interior demolition
- Complete building demolition
- Asbestos removal
- Mould remediation
- Foundation excavation
- Site clearing after demolition

**Not offered:** concrete, asphalt paving, building construction, utility installation.

Gerald & Kate Holdings is newly established and does not yet have a completed contract history under its current corporate name. The work above was completed by the principals individually. The company has access to two excavators and experienced personnel and can supplement its workforce and resources against any project scope and schedule.

## Ground conditions

Central Alberta clay holds water and shrinks when dry. Freeze–thaw cycles fail roads in spring rather than summer. Organic topsoil is worth more than the mineral soil beneath it. Work is planned around these conditions.

## Service area

Home base is Calgary. Coverage includes Calgary and Calgary metro (Okotoks, Airdrie, Cochrane, Chestermere, High River, Black Diamond), Red Deer, Rocky View County, Red Deer County, Blackfalds, Sylvan Lake, Clive, Delburne, Caroline, Lacombe, Ponoka, Innisfail and Red Bluff. Travel beyond these areas on request.
